CHECK ((status <> 'previewReady') OR preview_id IS NOT NULL)
CHECK ((status <> 'applied') OR applied_plan_version_id IS NOT NULL)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "areas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_life" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_life" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "area_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES areas (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "area_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES areas (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "estimated_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remaining_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "available_from_utc" INTEGER NULL, "energy_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "split_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_chunk_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_chunk_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "preferred_start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "preferred_end_minute" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_tags" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurrence_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interval_weeks" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (interval_weeks BETWEEN 1 AND 52), "valid_from_local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "valid_until_local_date" TEXT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "academic_terms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_week_monday_local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_weeks" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_weeks BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timetable_import_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "term_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES academic_terms (id), "source_image_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_event_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'committed', 'partiallyDeleted', 'rolledBack')), CHECK (created_event_count >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence_rule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurrence_rules (id), "exception_of_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES calendar_events (id), "locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("locked" IN (0, 1)), "area_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES areas (id), "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "location" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fixed', "import_batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES timetable_import_batches (id), "logical_course_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "period_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "period_template_entries" ("template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES period_templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "period_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("template_id", "period_number"), CHECK (period_number > 0), CHECK (start_minute >= 0 AND start_minute < end_minute AND end_minute <= 1440));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "energy_windows" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "energy_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "json_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_versions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "input_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "algorithm_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_blocks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_versions (id), "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "start_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("locked" IN (0, 1)), "explanation_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "time_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "started_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "paused_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "recovery_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_corrections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "previous_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "corrected_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "corrected_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preference_evidence" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "numeric_value" REAL NULL, "special_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("special_day" IN (0, 1)), "metadata_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preference_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "change_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_task_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "area_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES areas (id), "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "target_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_minutes > 0), "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "energy_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "split_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_chunk_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_chunk_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "preferred_start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "preferred_end_minute" INTEGER NULL, "pace" TEXT NOT NULL, "allowed_weekdays_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 127 CHECK (allowed_weekdays_mask BETWEEN 1 AND 127), "carry_over_unfinished" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("carry_over_unfinished" IN (0, 1)), "starts_on_local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "ends_on_local_date" TEXT NULL, "paused_until_local_date" TEXT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived')), CHECK (min_chunk_minutes > 0 AND max_chunk_minutes >= min_chunk_minutes), CHECK ((preferred_start_minute IS NULL) = (preferred_end_minute IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_task_cycles" ("template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurring_task_templates (id), "period_start_local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES tasks (id), "base_target_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (base_target_minutes > 0), "carry_in_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (carry_in_minutes >= 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("template_id", "period_start_local_date"), CHECK (status IN ('open', 'met', 'missed', 'skipped')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_runtime_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES time_entries (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "feature_enabled_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1), CHECK (revision >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_write_sequence" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1), CHECK (next_value >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_operations" ("data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "request_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "command_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NULL, "result_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("data_epoch", "operation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "origin_plan_version_id" TEXT NULL, "origin_block_id" TEXT NULL, "baseline_start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "baseline_end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "baseline_time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "baseline_local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "baseline_planned_duration_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current_plan_version_id" TEXT NULL, "allocated_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remaining_allocation_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_start_evidence_id" TEXT NULL, "withdrawal_reason" TEXT NULL, "withdrawn_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "lifecycle_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "privacy_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (baseline_end_utc > baseline_start_utc), CHECK (baseline_planned_duration_micros >= 0), CHECK (allocated_micros >= 0), CHECK (remaining_allocation_micros >= 0), CHECK (remaining_allocation_micros <= allocated_micros), CHECK (revision >= 1), CHECK (lifecycle_state IN ('planned', 'started', 'finished', 'withdrawn')), CHECK (privacy_state IN ('linked', 'anonymized')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_block_links" ("data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_versions (id), "block_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES execution_occurrences (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_block_id" TEXT NULL, "reserved_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fragment_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("data_epoch", "plan_version_id", "block_id"), CHECK (reserved_micros >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_events" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sub_event_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurrence_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES execution_occurrences (id), "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recorded_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "corrected_event_id" TEXT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id"), UNIQUE (operation_id, sub_event_index), CHECK (sub_event_index >= 0), CHECK (sequence >= 1), CHECK (revision >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_session_links" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES time_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES execution_occurrences (id), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_accepted_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id"), CHECK (revision >= 1), CHECK (source IN ('realtime', 'manual', 'recoveryConfirmed', 'legacyUnlinked')), CHECK (mode IN ('planned', 'actualOnly')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_activity_segments" ("segment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES time_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "invalidated_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("segment_id"), UNIQUE (session_id, sequence), CHECK (end_utc > start_utc), CHECK (sequence >= 1), CHECK (source IN ('realtime', 'manual', 'recoveryConfirmed', 'legacyUnlinked')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_progress_anchors" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "anchor_remaining_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "anchor_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_current" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_current" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "revision"), CHECK (revision >= 1), CHECK (anchor_remaining_micros >= 0), CHECK (anchor_sequence >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_credit_allocations" ("data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "segment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES execution_activity_segments (segment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "allocation_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "record_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_accepted_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("segment_id", "target_kind", "target_id", "allocation_index", "record_revision"), CHECK (amount_micros > 0), CHECK (allocation_index >= 0), CHECK (record_revision >= 1), CHECK (first_accepted_sequence >= 1), CHECK (target_kind IN ('task', 'recurringCycle')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_reminder_intents" ("data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES execution_occurrences (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notification_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "claimed_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "scheduled_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "dispatch_result" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("occurrence_id", "revision", "data_epoch"), CHECK (revision >= 1), CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'scheduled', 'suppressed', 'expired', 'unknown', 'cancelled', 'handled')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_day_holds" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "invalid_after_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_proposal_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "local_date", "time_zone_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_outbox" ("effect_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_transaction" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effect_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_attempt_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "processed_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("effect_id"), CHECK (attempts >= 0), CHECK (target_revision >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_cycle_snapshots" ("cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transport_task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_start_local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period_end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effective_start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effective_end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "area_id" TEXT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "energy_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "split_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_chunk_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_chunk_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "preferred_start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "preferred_end_minute" INTEGER NULL, "pace" TEXT NOT NULL, "allowed_weekdays_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "carry_in_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "settled_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cycle_id"), UNIQUE (template_id, period_start_local_date), CHECK (period_end_utc > period_start_utc), CHECK (effective_end_utc > effective_start_utc), CHECK (effective_start_utc >= period_start_utc), CHECK (effective_end_utc <= period_end_utc), CHECK (target_minutes > 0), CHECK (carry_in_minutes >= 0), CHECK (revision >= 1), CHECK ((preferred_start_minute IS NULL) = (preferred_end_minute IS NULL)), CHECK (state IN ('open', 'met', 'missed', 'skipped')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_carry_in_states" ("cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "provisional" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("provisional" IN (0, 1)), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cycle_id"), CHECK (revision >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_fragments" ("fragment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES execution_occurrences (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "cycle_id" TEXT NULL, "root_fragment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_fragment_id" TEXT NULL, "plan_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_versions (id), "block_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "allocated_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("fragment_id"), UNIQUE (plan_version_id, block_id), CHECK (planned_end_utc > planned_start_utc), CHECK (planned_minutes > 0), CHECK (allocated_micros >= 0), CHECK (completed_micros >= 0), CHECK (completed_micros <= allocated_micros), CHECK (revision >= 1), CHECK (state IN ('planned', 'started', 'completed', 'withdrawn', 'superseded')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_completion_evidence" ("evidence_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fragment_id" TEXT NULL, "amount_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "reverses_evidence_id" TEXT NULL, "recorded_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effective_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("evidence_id"), UNIQUE (idempotency_key), CHECK (amount_micros > 0), CHECK (sequence >= 1), CHECK (revision >= 1), CHECK (kind IN ('activity', 'fragmentCompletion', 'manualAdjustment', 'correction')), CHECK (kind <> 'correction' OR reverses_evidence_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_plan_previews" ("preview_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recurring-lookahead', "base_plan_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "algorithm_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "window_start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "window_end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "summary_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "diagnostics_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "proposal_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "proposal_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "format_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("preview_id"), CHECK (window_end_utc > window_start_utc), CHECK (revision >= 1), CHECK (format_version >= 1), CHECK (kind IN ('recurringLookahead', 'deferAdjustment')), CHECK (status IN ('active', 'superseded', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'stale')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_plan_preview_blocks" ("preview_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pending_plan_previews (preview_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "block_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL, "cycle_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "explanation_code" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("preview_id", "block_id"), CHECK (end_utc > start_utc), CHECK (minutes > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_adjustments" ("adjustment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_block_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_title_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_plan_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "not_before_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "requested_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "requested_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "target_sibling_block_ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "preview_id" TEXT NULL, "applied_plan_version_id" TEXT NULL, "failure_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("adjustment_id"), CHECK (source_end_utc > source_start_utc), CHECK (not_before_utc > source_start_utc), CHECK (expires_at_utc > created_at_utc), CHECK (requested_amount > 0), CHECK (revision >= 1), CHECK (kind IN ('defer')), CHECK (requested_unit IN ('minutes', 'hours', 'days')), CHECK (status IN ('active', 'generating', 'previewReady', 'applying', 'applied', 'cancelled', 'failed', 'stale', 'expired')), CHECK (failure_code IS NULL OR failure_code IN ('targetMissing', 'targetChanged', 'targetIneligible', 'basePlanChanged', 'previewExpired', 'tokenMismatch', 'noLegalSlot', 'deadlineExceeded', 'disallowedWeekday', 'taskDailyLimitReached', 'globalDailyLimitReached', 'requiredBreakUnavailable', 'fixedOrProtectedConflict', 'searchBudgetExhausted', 'invariantViolation', 'fulfilmentMissing', 'fulfilmentDurationMismatch', 'concurrentModification')), CHECK ((status <> 'previewReady') OR preview_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK ((status <> 'applied') OR applied_plan_version_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_adjustment_events" ("adjustment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_adjustments (adjustment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("adjustment_id", "sequence"), CHECK (sequence >= 1), CHECK (revision >= 1));
